lines.text: Athaliah destroys the royal heirs, but Jehosheba hides Joash and his nurse in the LORD's house for six years.
Jehoiada makes a covenant with the commanders in the house of the LORD and shows them the king's son.
Jehoiada gives the commanders the spears and shields of King Saul, then crowns the king's son, and they anoint him.
Athaliah sees the king by the pillar, cries "Murder!", and is seized at the horses' entrance and put to death.
